records.source: Did you watch the game last night?#$b#Or wait, do you even have a TV set...?
records.translation: 你昨晚有看比賽嗎？#$b#等等，你家到底有沒有電視……？

records.source: Ugh, I stepped in something gross earlier... and I just bought these shoes.$s
records.translation: 呃，我剛才踩到一團噁心的東西……這雙鞋才剛買耶。$s

records.source: Hey, I'm Sam. Good to meet you.$h
records.translation: 嘿，我是山姆。很高興認識你。$h

records.source: Aw yeah... Pizza time!$h
records.translation: 太棒了……吃披薩的時間！$h

records.source: Hey, hey, hey! You remembered! Now that's what I'm talking about!$h
records.translation: 嘿、嘿、嘿！你記得！這才像話嘛！$h

records.source: Hey, hey, hey! You rememb--$h#$b#...*sniff*...*sniff*... what's that gnarly smell...?$8#$b#...Oh.$5
Oh... with me? Hehe... Yeah, sure. Sounds fun!$10
records.translation: 喔……和我嗎？嘿嘿……好啊，當然可以。聽起來很好玩！$10

records.source: Whaa! Is it acid? Will it burn through the roof and sizzle us alive?$8#$b#I gotta keep my little brother safe!$7
records.translation: 哇啊！那是酸嗎？會不會燒穿屋頂，把我們活活熔掉？$8#$b#我得保護弟弟！$7

records.source: Seems like there's no damage to anything... That was a strange one. How are you holding up?
records.translation: 看來沒有任何東西受損……真是場怪雨。你還好嗎？

records.source: You notice how warm this rain is? It feels alive...
records.translation: 你有發現這場雨有多溫暖嗎？感覺像是活的……

records.source: Um... So, can I get a kiss now?$l
records.translation: 嗯……那我現在可以得到一個吻嗎？$l

records.source: I couldn't sleep last night. I was imagining all the things we're gonna do together.$10
records.translation: 我昨晚睡不著，一直想像我們要一起做的所有事情。$10

records.source: Whoaa... Hold on... this is for me? I never expected this! Thank you!
records.translation: 哇啊……等等……這是給我的？完全沒想到！謝謝你！

records.source: I heard you and Sebastian are going out... he better still be coming to band practice every week!
records.translation: 我聽說你和賽巴斯汀在交往……他最好還是每週都來參加樂團練習！

records.source: Wow, I can't believe you and Sebastian got hitched. Times really are changing...$u#$e#Eh, it's alright, I'm sure he'll still have time to hang out.
records.translation: 哇，真不敢相信你和賽巴斯汀結婚了。時代真的變了……$u#$e#呃，沒關係啦，他一定還是有時間一起玩的。

records.source: Hey, what's the big idea? You took my drummer!$8#$b#Haha, just kidding... Congrats!$h
records.translation: 嘿，這算什麼？你把我的鼓手搶走了！$8#$b#哈哈，開玩笑的……恭喜！$h

records.source: I better lay low for a while. I wouldn't want to get on Mayor Lewis' bad side!
records.translation: 我最好低調一陣子。可不想得罪路易斯鎮長！

records.source: Heheh... So you've been to the sewer, huh? I've snuck down there a few times myself. It's pretty creepy.#$e#How could I tell? Hmm... let's just say... 'the nose knows'.$h
records.translation: 嘿嘿……所以你去過下水道了，對吧？我自己也偷偷溜下去過幾次。那裡相當嚇人。#$e#我怎麼知道的？嗯……只能說……「鼻子最清楚」。$h

records.source: Wouldn't it be cool if the town had a skate park, though?#$b#Now, how to convince Mayor Lewis...$s
records.translation: 不過，如果鎮上有座滑板公園，不是很酷嗎？#$b#接下來要想想怎麼說服路易斯鎮長……$s

records.source: Even with all the practice we did, I made a bunch of mistakes on stage... I hope no one noticed.$s#$e#It's kind of nerve-wracking to be in front of everyone!$h
records.translation: 即使練習了那麼久，我在台上還是犯了一堆錯……希望沒有人注意到。$s#$e#站在大家面前真的有點緊張！$h

records.source: If... I mean when... my Dad gets back, I wonder if he'll be the same as I remember him?$s
records.translation: 如果……我是說等……爸爸回來時，不知道他會不會還和我記憶中一樣？$s

records.source: Wow, what a spot!
records.translation: 哇，這地方真棒！

records.source: I bet there's some cool stuff deeper on the island.#$e#Willy said we have to stay here, though... some kind of liability issues or something.$s
records.translation: 我敢說島嶼深處有些很酷的東西。#$e#不過威利說我們必須待在這裡……好像是什麼責任問題之類的。$s

records.source: I'm feeling pretty good from all the sunlight.$h
records.translation: 曬了這麼多陽光，感覺真不錯。$h

records.source: Check out these gnarly waves... Guess what? I'm gonna save up for a surfboard.
records.translation: 看看這些超猛的浪……你猜怎樣？我要存錢買塊衝浪板。

records.source: %Sam is playing a jazzy tune on his guitar.
records.translation: %Sam正用吉他彈奏一首爵士風格的曲子。

records.source: Maybe I should learn to play the ukulele.#$e#Abby on the congas and Sebastian on the steel drums... 'The Pelicans of Paradise'...$s#$e#What's the matter, you look worried.$h
records.translation: 也許我該學彈烏克麗麗。#$e#艾比打康加鼓，賽巴斯汀打鋼鼓……「天堂鵜鶘」……$s#$e#怎麼了？你看起來很擔心。$h

records.source: I'm just getting juiced up, then it's back to the beach.
records.translation: 我只是來補充點能量，接著就回海灘。

records.source: Aw, I gotta put on that dorky suit again? I thought now that we're married... Well, alright.$s
records.translation: 啊，我又得穿上那套呆板的西裝嗎？我還以為既然我們結婚了……好吧。$s

records.source: Hmm... I dunno. Maybe next year.$s
records.translation: 嗯……不知道耶。也許明年吧。$s

records.source: Alright, I'm done with the cold shoulder act. Let's just forget about what happened.$7
records.translation: 好啦，我不再擺冷臉了。就忘掉發生過的事吧。$7

records.source: Wait... what?!$8#$b#I thought we were doing okay... I guess I was way off... alright, then.$9#$b#Yeah, sure... we can still be friends.$9
records.translation: 等等……什麼？！$8#$b#我以為我們相處得不錯……看來我完全搞錯了……那好吧。$9#$b#嗯，當然……我們還是可以做朋友。$9

records.source: I'm sorry, @. I don't think I can still be your friend.$s
records.translation: 對不起，@。我想我們沒辦法繼續做朋友。$s

records.source: Hey, how's it going?#$e#Last night I practiced guitar for 4 hours straight. My fingers hurt like crazy.$s#$e#Bye, I've got something to do...
records.translation: 嘿，最近如何？#$e#昨晚我連續練了四個小時的吉他。手指痛得要命。$s#$e#再見，我還有事要做……

records.source: Hey, farmer.
records.translation: 嘿，農夫。

records.source: I'll tell you a secret... my name 'Sam' is short for 'Samson'.$10#$e#Most people don't know that so keep it on mute.
records.translation: 告訴你一個祕密……我的名字「山姆」其實是「山姆森」的簡稱。$10#$e#大多數人都不知道，所以要替我保密。

records.source: Oh, hi! It's good to see you again.#$e#Take it easy.
records.translation: 喔，嗨！很高興又見到你。#$e#放輕鬆。

records.source: Hi, @. Do you want to hang out or something?#$e#Sleeping feels nice but sometimes I wish I could skip it... it's just such a time-waster.
records.translation: 嗨，@。想一起混混時間什麼的嗎？#$e#睡覺的感覺不錯，但有時真希望可以省略……實在太浪費時間了。

records.source: I'm trying to come up with a new song for my band, but I'm blanking...#$q 19/20 Wed_old#Hey.. What do you think my new song should be about?#$r 20 30 Wed_20#Farming, mining, and chopping wood.#$r 8820 30 Wed_20#A city in the sea.#$r 8821 30 Wed_20#Trains.#$r 19 -50 Wed_19#Choose anything. It'll still be a horrible song.
records.translation: 我想替樂團創作一首新歌，但腦袋一片空白……#$q 19/20 Wed_old#嘿……你覺得我的新歌該寫什麼？#$r 20 30 Wed_20#務農、採礦和砍柴。#$r 8820 30 Wed_20#海中的城市。#$r 8821 30 Wed_20#火車。#$r 19 -50 Wed_19#隨便選。反正還是會很難聽。

records.source: $p 19#But I already know what you think about it.$a|Thanks to your help I'm already done with the lyrics!$h
records.translation: $p 19#但我已經知道你對這件事的看法。$a|多虧你的幫忙，我已經寫完歌詞了！$h

records.source: Hey, man... what the heck is your problem? Sorry I asked.$a
records.translation: 嘿，老兄……你到底有什麼毛病？當我沒問。$a

records.source: Hey, you know what? That sounds perfect. Thanks!$h
records.translation: 嘿，你知道嗎？聽起來太完美了。謝啦！$h

records.source: I've been friends with Sebastian for a while. He's a pretty cool guy.#$e#If you two weren't around I wouldn't really have any friends in town.
records.translation: 我和賽巴斯汀做朋友有一段時間了。他是個很酷的傢伙。#$e#如果你們兩個不在，我在鎮上就真的沒有朋友了。

records.source: Hey buddy. You look like you're full of energy today!^@. Um... I just wanted to say... You look nice today.$10
records.translation: 嘿，老兄。你今天看起來活力十足！^@。嗯……我只是想說……你今天很好看。$10

records.source: I think my Dad might be coming back in a year or so.#$e#I guess you might be able to meet him, then. If you're still living here.#$e#You wouldn't abandon the farm after putting so much effort into it!
records.translation: 我想爸爸大概再過一年左右就會回來。#$e#到時你也許能見到他。只要你還住在這裡。#$e#你在農場投入了那麼多心血，不會就這樣離開吧！

records.source: ...I have mixed feelings about my father being back. He seems strange.$s#$b#But I guess I haven't seen him in 3 years... so that could explain it.
records.translation: ……對於爸爸回來這件事，我的心情很複雜。他感覺怪怪的。$s#$b#不過我們畢竟三年沒見了……也許這就是原因。

records.source: *sigh*... what am I still doing here?
records.translation: *嘆氣*……我怎麼還待在這裡？

records.source: The clouds look great this time of year, don't they?#$e#Like scoops of vanilla ice cream floating on blue raspberry sauce... Or maybe I'm just hungry.
records.translation: 每年這個時候的雲都很好看，對吧？#$e#就像一球球香草冰淇淋漂浮在藍莓醬上……也許我只是餓了。

records.source: My Dad is a soldier, fighting against the Gotoro Empire. That's why he's not here...#$e#He'll come back someday.#$e#...I've heard some terrible things about the Gotoro Empire...$s
records.translation: 爸爸是軍人，正在和戈特羅帝國作戰。所以他不在這裡……#$e#他總有一天會回來。#$e#……我聽說過一些關於戈特羅帝國的可怕事情……$s

records.source: Well, my Dad is back. Have you met him?#$b#I'm just glad he's okay.
records.translation: 嗯，爸爸回來了。你見過他嗎？#$b#他平安無事，我就很高興了。

records.source: Well, my Dad is back. Have you met him?#$b#I'm just glad he's okay.
records.translation: 嗯，爸爸回來了。你見過他嗎？#$b#他平安無事，我就很高興了。

records.source: Did I ever tell you we used to live in the city?#$e#There's a lot more stuff going on, but it's also kinda noisy and hectic... It's hard to say which is better.
records.translation: 我有告訴過你，我們以前住在城市裡嗎？#$e#那裡有更多事情可做，但也有點吵鬧忙亂……很難說哪裡比較好。

records.source: Dad used to work as a garbage man in the city.#$e#You don't even want to know some of the things he found in people's trash.
records.translation: 爸爸以前在城市裡當垃圾清運工。#$e#他在人們的垃圾裡發現過一些東西，你絕對不會想知道。

records.source: The older I get the more attached I feel to the valley.#$b#Although I could be biased... for a certain reason.$10#$e#So, how are you doing today?$h
records.translation: 年紀越大，我就越眷戀這座山谷。#$b#不過我也可能不太客觀……因為某個特別的理由。$10#$e#所以，你今天過得如何？$h

records.source: Oh! I just remembered I'm supposed to call my Grandma. Okay, I'm going to put this rubber band on my wrist so I don't forget.#$e#I have to make little reminders for myself or else I'll totally forget to do things.$h
records.translation: 喔！我剛想起來應該打電話給奶奶。好，我要把這條橡皮筋套在手腕上，免得忘記。#$e#我必須替自己做些小提醒，不然會把該做的事忘得一乾二淨。$h

records.source: Hmm. I just remembered that I was meaning to do something... But I forgot.#$e#This happens to me all the time.
records.translation: 嗯。我剛想起來自己本來要做某件事……但忘記是什麼了。#$e#這種事總是發生在我身上。

records.source: Sometimes I wonder if my mother is actually happy with her life...$s#$e#I asked her once and got the feeling she was hiding some inner pain.
records.translation: 有時我會想，媽媽對自己的人生是否真的感到幸福……$s#$e#我曾經問過她一次，感覺她內心藏著某種痛苦。

records.source: Oh, it's a nice day... isn't it?
records.translation: 喔，今天真不錯……對吧？
